title: Users with and without Create & Edit see the same Part Library toolbar
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location in one browser.
  • Use a second browser, or a private window, signed in at the test location as user B, whose role has only 'Part Library & Inventory → View' in the Part Library and Inventory group (no Create & Edit, no Delete).
custom_steps:
1. In browser 1, click Parts in the top bar.
  2. In browser 1, click Part Library in the left menu.
  3. In browser 2, as user B, click Parts in the top bar.
  4. In browser 2, click Part Library in the left menu.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Parts left menu shows Part Library.

Step 2:

  • The Admin sees the title "Part Library" with Search, "Manufacturer: All manufacturers" and "Category: All categories", and no control that creates an entry.

Step 3:

  • User B's Parts left menu shows Part Library.

Step 4:

  • User B sees exactly the same title and toolbar: "Part Library", Search, "Manufacturer: All manufacturers" and "Category: All categories".
  • Nothing is added or missing for either user.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only)

  • S11-R7: “A user with the 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' permission and a user without it see the same Part Library toolbar.”
  • S11-R1: “The Part Library page has no control that creates a Part Library entry.”
